svg.title: Tight Frames, Chowla–Selberg Scaling, and the Integral Vacuum intVacuum
svg.desc: Publication-grade editorial mathematical diagram tracing the four-stage construction of the globally integral, conjugate-bounded vacuum theta^circ = intVacuum from a single CM elliptic curve in Stage 02 (src/New/Derivatives/Vacuum/TightFrames.lean and IntegralVacuum.lean). Stage 1 (top-left) depicts the anchor CM curve P.cmCurve = C / (Omega_0 O_K) for K = Q(sqrt(-d)) with d = 7 mod 8, period parallelogram of area |Omega_0|^2 sqrt(d)/2 and 2-torsion point t, together with the Chowla-Selberg unit u (|iota_p(u)| = 1 at every prime p) pinning every conjugate area via area(E^sigma) |sigma u|^2 = pi exp(c_d) (2 pi / sqrt(d)), and the exact scale formula jetScale = periodFactor sqrt(2 pi / sqrt(d)) / Omega_0 whose transcendental period Omega cancels across Galois conjugates to bigOmega^(-1). Stage 2 (top-right) displays a roots-of-unity tight frame spoke diagram 1, zeta, zeta^2, ..., zeta^(q_1 - 1) (isTightFrame_pow and isTightFrame_zeta_pow) realizing character orthogonality sum m_j Phi_sigma(w_j) conj(Phi_tau(w_j)) = M delta_{sigma,tau} and metric pullback sum pullForm(L_{j,k}, m_j H_C) = u^* v; pulling back 1D monomial sections theta^r (sigma^2)^t G^u builds IsResolutionProduct and specializes to a level-1 IsThetaProduct F with V.theta(F) = 1, |iota_p(F(finVec x))| <= 1 at all primes p, and period lattice q_1 a_0^n. Stage 3 (bottom-left) descends from F to V.vacElem via an unnormalized finite Heisenberg sum (exists_smul_vacElem_eq_sum): c V.vacElem = sum_{j in Gamma} V.finHeisenbergOp(a_j)(V.rho(finVec b) F) over |Gamma| = (q_1^2)^(fn) <= exp(2 q_1^2 n) shifts with explicitly NO division by |Gamma| so p-adic integrality is preserved at every prime, combined with a uniform torsion conjugate bound M giving archimedean control. Stage 4 (bottom-right) defines the rank-n integral vacuum theta^circ = intVacuum V = (vacuumScale)^n vacElem (isVacuumScale_vacuumScale) with three verified property badges: global p-adic integrality (norm_intVacuum_le_one), uniform conjugate bound |sigma(theta^circ(finVec x))| <= exp(C q_1^2 n) for all sigma in Aut(C) (norm_ringEquiv_intVacuum_le), and nonvanishing plus Galois jet conjugation (exists_intVacuum_ne_zero, standardData V delta, exists_isJetConjugate_translates), feeding Count.lean and Stages 01 and 03-07.
